name: tests/__init__.py
summary: Initializes the dataset app tests directory as a Python package.
purpose: Allows the tests directory to be treated as a Python package, enabling test discovery and organized imports of test modules within the dataset application.
responsibilities: Mark the tests directory as a valid Python package
Optionally expose shared test utilities, base classes, or fixtures
Support relative imports between test modules
outputs: Package namespace for dataset app test modules
architecture_notes: Standard Python package initializer following Django app structure conventions. Typically empty unless shared test infrastructure (e.g., factories, mixins) is centralized here. Facilitates test runner discovery in app-specific test suites.
improvements: Consider removing the file if using implicit namespace packages (PEP 420) and no shared initialization is required
Populate with shared test fixtures or base TestCase classes if test modules contain duplicated setup logic
Add package-level documentation if the file contains non-obvious test configuration
